regions.name: Central Empire
regions.terrain: Temperate grasslands and fertile river valleys, wooded Bak, salt marsh O’Myre, mountainous north.
regions.agricultural_area_qualitative: High potential on plains/river farms; separate settlement/cultivation from protected Bak and sacred core; wetlands not automatic fields.

regions.bottleneck: Capital≥680k food basin must include Neckoffoods + hinterland + bay imports; bridges/gates/docks and storage needed.

regions.name: Freelands

regions.trade: Iron,copper,tin,timber,monster parts; livestock/leather→Stravian attested; luxury imported.

regions.surface_policy: no area from graphic frame; measured projected land mask still requires legal/ecological/soil/relief exclusions

regions.bottleneck: Large caravans stop Begraense; small caravans and aerial mounts onward; severe seasonal closures.
regions.surface_policy: no area from graphic frame; measured projected land mask still requires legal/ecological/soil/relief exclusions
